title: No 3D presence: she walks over doors and building fronts
details: (Owner, in chat, 2026-09-26) "I FEEL LIKE THE 3D PRESENCE IS NOT THERE, FOR EXAMPLE I WALK OVER DOORS". Doors/walls/building fronts need proper depth: things in front of her draw over her, she walks INTO a door (it opens) instead of over it.

thread.author: agent
thread.text: Built and merged in the premium pass (ADR 0015): y-sorted depth, doors open and she walks in.
